description: Variation of Condition 5 (opening hours) to allow the hours of opening to be 9am to midnight Monday to Saturday and 9am to 11pm Sunday's and Bank Holiday's of planning permission 00610/123/P11 approved 07/02/2019  for change of use from Retail (A1) to Restaurant (Use Class A3) with ancillary takeaway (A5) and extractor flue
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2518- 01/FP; 2518- 02/FP; 2518- 03/FP; 2518- 04/FP; 2518- 05/FP; Design and Access Statement; Delivery Statement. Received 13/12/2018. 2518- 06/FP. Received 19/12/2018 approved under planning permission 00610/123/P11 dated 7 February 2019 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The ventilation flue hereby permitted shall be subject to regular servicing and maintenance In accordance with the manufacturer's recommended best practice. Records of such works shall be documented and retained for not less than one year and kept available for inspection by the Council if so requested. 

Condition : 4 - The opening hours of the premises for customers shall be 09:00 am to 12:00 pm between Monday and Saturday and 09:00 am to 11:00 pm on Sundays and public holidays and no staff activity shall take place after midnight on any day or before 08:30 am the following day other than that necessary for the premises to be vacated and secured.
Condition : 5 - The level of noise emitted from any commercial plant installed at the premises shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24 hour period in accordance with the guidance set by BS 4142:2014.
Condition : 6 - Not less than three 240 litre bins shall been kept available on site at all times within the area for refuse storage shown on the plans approved under planning permission 00610/123/P11, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling. The storage area and bins shall be kept permanently and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the identified storage area. Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week. Waste shall be removed as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collections, unless additional covered and enclosed bins have been provided and stored inside the building and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
